import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String email = scanner.nextLine();
        System.out.println(solve(email));
        scanner.close();
    }

    public static String solve(String email) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(email);

        // handle @
        int atPos = sb.indexOf("at", 1);
        if (atPos != -1) {
            sb.replace(atPos, atPos + 2, "@");
        }

        // handle dot
        int dotPos = sb.indexOf("dot", 1);
        while (dotPos != -1 && sb.length() != dotPos + 3) {
            sb.replace(dotPos, dotPos + 3, ".");
            dotPos = sb.indexOf("dot", 1);
        }

        return sb.toString();
    }
}
